gap: No result ChatGPT got works out the price per Wh, or the hours to refill from the kit's own panels, for any 5 kWh kit that is sold with its panels at one price. Worked out: Jackery Solar Generator 5000 Plus + 2× SolarSaga 500 X $5,159 ÷ 5,040 Wh = $1.02/Wh, 5.0 h; Anker SOLIX S5000 + 400W $3,099.99 ÷ 5,024 Wh = $0.62/Wh, 8.4 h counting the free 200 W panel; BLUETTI 5kWh RV Kit + 6×100W $4,369.05 ÷ 5,120 Wh = $0.85/Wh, 8.5 h; BLUETTI Apex 200 + B300K + 2×200W $2,659.05 ÷ 5,324.8 Wh = $0.50/Wh, 13.3 h. Refill hours are battery Wh ÷ panel W at rated output.
standout_why: Compared against six pages. stormwatts.com/articles/240v-solar-generators-solar-input-compared (cited) prices the 5 kWh stations without panels ($/kWh) and gives refill hours with a 0.85 factor for brand panels it never prices as a bundle. stormwatts.com/articles/solar-generator-kits-compared-same-panel-watts and stormwatts.com/articles/solar-generator-bundle-vs-buying-separately (cited) have no kit above 4,096 Wh. energysage.com (cited) has $/Wh for stations only (DELTA Pro 3 $0.78) and refill hours from each station's maximum solar input, not from included panels. Neither of ChatGPT's answers priced a 5 kWh kit per Wh or tied refill time to the panels in the box: its tables use generic 400–2,000 W arrays. lightsonlabs.com returned a certificate error and could not be read.
decides: It overturns ChatGPT's value case for its top pick. The Jackery kit costs $1.02/Wh, about 65% more per Wh than Anker's S5000 + 400W kit at $0.62/Wh, though Jackery's 1,000 W of panels refill it fastest (5.0 h). Both are pre-orders today. The kits that ship now are the BLUETTI 5kWh RV kits (per Dealectric's kit table, read 2026-11-17), and refill hours decide which one to pick. The 2×100W kit is the cheapest per Wh ($0.74) but needs 25.6 h of rated sun to refill, which is unusable for a 5 kWh battery. The 6×100W kit refills in 8.5 h, about the same as the Anker kit, for $0.85/Wh. That makes 6×100W the ship-now pick and 4×100W (12.8 h, $0.80/Wh) the budget option. For a shopper who can wait, Apex 200 + B300K + 2×200W is the cheapest per Wh at $0.50 but dispatches late January 2027 and is 120 V only at 3,200 W. Anker S5000 + 400W is $0.62/Wh with 240 V and ships 9–10 weeks after order.
